scope: Existing measured track extended to ordinary rear travel; explicit cadence comparison, no observation LOD claim.
finding: CBE measured curvature discarded every reverse sample; rear geometry therefore used native instantaneous yaw rather than actual travelled chord.
implementation: Optional travel direction selects unit side/forward axes; direction enters existing private identity so a reversal cannot inherit the opposite-direction sample.
Existing three-metre/1.5-second sample, six-second age, <=1m/s along-travel reset and 250m straightness threshold retained. Invalid direction returns no receipt.
Ordinary rear geometry consumes its own measured chord, never a forward native path/support hint. Convoy callers retain default forward frame.
No new history scan, world query, scheduler, worker or timer. Existing curved-ray bound unchanged; selected fan and aggregate cost can differ from former yaw fallback.
cadenceDecision: No player-distance slowdown implemented. CBE already uses 4s cruise/1s constrained cadence with 4s reaction accounting; HBQ factors are1..2.2s. No physical response-latency evidence justifies extending CBE intervals. Precision/LOD gap remains explicit, not counted as implemented.
remaining: Physical reverse bends, braking/flow, direction changes, locality/HC repeats and performance remain unverified. Audits paused.
Complete HBQ source integration and external-controller handovers remain incomplete.
